topic: Mitchell-Netravali (B=1/3, C=1/3) cubic reconstruction filter vs over-sharpened Gibbs ringing
topic_zh: Mitchell-Netravali (B=1/3, C=1/3) 单位分解三次重构滤波与吉布斯振铃对比
